item.title: DX Intelligence Log
item.description:
Something wonderful is happening

Post tagged with ‘dxi’ is part of my coding project: shortwave.sbs and DX-Intelligence.

First Steps

  • The dxi directory was created.
  • This marks the beginning of the DX Intelligence Engine.
  • The existing shortwave.sbs application remains untouched.

“Today, DX Intelligence took its first concrete form. It can’t analyze any transmissions yet, but we built it its own home. I wanted to do this in a way that wouldn’t break any of the current features.”
